job: Ask in an item's own row whether to remove, revoke or sign it out, before the action runs.
purpose: A danger-tinted box in the row: the question, then a quiet Cancel and a small danger button named for the effect. A menu item or a button with data-fd-confirm-row opens it and focus moves to Cancel; Cancel and Escape close it and return focus. The danger button fires a cancelable fd:confirm; cancel it to run the work, then closeConfirmRow(el, { focus: 'next' }) or failConfirmRow(el, message).
useWhen: One item in a list or table is about to be removed, revoked or signed out, and the person stays on the list.
The action cannot be taken back, so it asks first.

avoidWhen.when: The action can be taken back in a few seconds.
It reaches far beyond one item, such as deleting a team.
The action has its own page, or must work without script.
The row is itself a link or a button, so it cannot hold buttons.

states.name: open
states.how: no hidden on the root (in a table, on its tr.fd-table-detail); openConfirmRow(el) or a data-fd-confirm-row trigger

states.name: busy
states.how: aria-busy="true" on the root after fd:confirm was cancelled; both buttons carry aria-disabled="true"

states.name: error
states.how: failConfirmRow(el, message) shows the message in fd-confirm-row-error and focuses the danger button

parts.role: The box; role="group" labelled by its text. The last child of a list row or an item's card, or alone in a table's detail row.
